solutions.check: grid rebuilt from the blog's light list (unique); every answer written into it with each crossing agreeing

clue.text: Trustworthy, but guilty

definitions.meaning: someone reliable who can be given charge of things
to blame, the one who caused something bad

explanation.definitionFit: The word means both reliable enough to be trusted with duties and accountable as the cause of a misdeed.

clue.text: Brazilian city needs diplomacy for control of civil disorder

parts.note: Rio de Janeiro is a city in Brazil
tact is diplomacy

explanation.surface: A Brazilian city needs diplomats to quell unrest.
explanation.walkthrough: The Riot Act was a British law read aloud to order a crowd to disperse; 'needs' and 'for' are links.
explanation.definitionFit: Reading the Riot Act was a legal step to make rioters disperse, so a means of crowd control.

clue.text: Spirit often drunk in ancient times

definitions.text: Spirit often drunk in ancient times

parts.words: Spirit often drunk in ancient times
parts.note: reads like a liquor popular long ago, but describes a classical woodland being who was a habitual drunkard

explanation.definitionFit: In Greek myth these goat-like woodland spirits followed Dionysus and were famed for drinking.

clue.text: Give short change in error

indicators.note: change signals the letters of the two words are altered into a new order

explanation.surface: A shopkeeper mistakenly hands over too little change.
explanation.walkthrough: 'short change' looks like a phrase, but 'change' is the anagram signal on GIVE SHORT; 'in' is a link.
explanation.definitionFit: An oversight is a mistake made through failing to notice something.

clue.text: Miss dance

definitions.meaning: to move with light hopping steps

explanation.definitionFit: The verb means both to leave something out and to hop lightly along.

clue.text: They've created a new bar scene

indicators.note: new signals a fresh arrangement of the letters in the words that follow

explanation.surface: Drinkers have produced a fresh look at the pub.
explanation.walkthrough: 'new' rearranges BAR SCENE; the clue also suggests discarded cans creating a scene.
explanation.definitionFit: The pronoun stands for the plural objects described, empty drink tins littering a bar.

clue.text: Aim to include me? Correct

indicators.note: to include means to take in, so one piece contains the other

parts.note: an end is an aim or goal

explanation.surface: Someone asks whether to add themselves, then confirms it is right.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Aim' reads as a verb but supplies its noun synonym; 'to include' takes in the second piece.
explanation.definitionFit: To emend a text is to correct its errors.

clue.text: Makes a fuss when a secret is found out

indicators.note: found out suggests the letters are sorted out into a new order

explanation.surface: Someone kicks up a row when their secret is exposed.
explanation.walkthrough: 'found out' rearranges A SECRET; 'when' and 'is' are links.
explanation.definitionFit: Informally, to create is to make a fuss or complain loudly.

clue.text: Know-all may appear to be perceptive over the port

indicators.note: in a down clue the first piece sits over the second

parts.note: wise means shrewd or perceptive
Acre is an ancient port in Israel

explanation.surface: A smart alec seems sharp after a glass of port.
explanation.walkthrough: 'port' suggests the drink but means the harbour town ACRE.
explanation.definitionFit: A wiseacre is someone who pretends to knowledge, a smart alec.

clue.text: At risk when making a call

definitions.meaning: speaking on the telephone, connected by a phone line

explanation.definitionFit: The idiom means in danger of loss, and literally describes someone connected on a telephone call.

clue.text: Pick Scrabble tile E

indicators.note: to scrabble is to scramble about, so these letters are jumbled into a new order

parts.note: the word tile is taken as written for rearranging; the answer also appears backwards across the clue's last words by coincidence
the letter E taken as written

explanation.surface: A Scrabble player picks out a tile showing the letter E.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Scrabble' looks like the board game, but it is the anagram signal: it turns TILE into ELIT, and E is added.
explanation.definitionFit: The pick of a group is its best members, the select few.

clue.text: A vote to the other side

parts.note: a voter marks a ballot paper with a cross

explanation.surface: Someone casts a ballot for the opposing party.
explanation.walkthrough: A voter puts a cross on the ballot paper, so 'vote' gives CROSS.
explanation.definitionFit: Going over from one side to the far side is a synonym phrase for this adverb.

clue.text: Dictates alternative way to prove gold genuine

indicators.note: an alternative arrangement of the letters of the word that precedes it

explanation.surface: Someone lays down a different method of checking that gold is real.
explanation.walkthrough: 'alternative' asks for another arrangement of the letters of DICTATES.
explanation.definitionFit: Assayers tested gold with nitric acid, which dissolves base metals but not true gold; the phrase now means any decisive trial.

clue.text: Boat about to leave for Caribbean island

indicators.note: about signals that the letters are turned around and rearranged

parts.note: to go is to leave

explanation.surface: A vessel is setting off for a West Indian island.
explanation.walkthrough: 'about' reshuffles the first word into TOBA; 'Boat' looks like the subject of the surface, but it is only fodder.
explanation.definitionFit: Tobago is the smaller island of the Caribbean nation Trinidad and Tobago.

clue.text: Is it similar to a hurricane light?

definitions.text: Is it similar to a hurricane light?

parts.words: Is it similar to a hurricane light?
parts.note: a hurricane lamp is a storm-proof lantern; the clue imagines a lamp with gale force, a torch giving a fierce jet of flame

explanation.definitionFit: A plumber's torch producing a hot directed flame, jokingly likened to a stormy lantern.

clue.text: Looks closely — about time to be wearing glasses?

parts.note: someone wearing a coat is in a coat

indicators.note: about here means around, so one piece goes round the other

parts.note: specs is short for spectacles

explanation.surface: Someone peers hard and wonders if it is time to start wearing spectacles.
explanation.walkthrough: 'about' places one piece around the other, giving SPECTS; 'to be' is a link. 'about time' looks like a phrase meaning overdue.
explanation.definitionFit: To inspect is to examine something carefully, which a verb phrase for looking closely matches.

clue.text: Vessel — right one in which to serve stew

parts.note: a pot is a vessel
to pour drinks is to serve them
I is the Roman numeral for one

explanation.surface: A cook picks the right pot for serving a stew.
explanation.walkthrough: 'in which to' is a link; the French word originally meant a stew of mixed meats.
explanation.definitionFit: Originally a French mixed-meat stew, the word later came to mean any medley.

clue.text: General artiste who played a small part in Barnum's circus

definitions.text: General artiste who played a small part in Barnum's circus

parts.words: General artiste who played a small part in Barnum's circus
parts.note: describes the tiny performer billed with a military title in P T Barnum's American show; small part puns on his size

explanation.definitionFit: Charles Stratton, billed as General Tom Thumb, was a famous dwarf performer for Barnum.

clue.text: Taking trouble to point out

parts.note: ado means fuss or bother

indicators.note: out signals the letters are put out of their usual order

explanation.surface: Going to the trouble of pointing something out.
explanation.walkthrough: 'out' rearranges the fodder into PTION; 'to' is a link. 'Taking' is the noun sense, the act of taking on.
explanation.definitionFit: Adoption is the taking up of a child, an idea or a policy as one's own.

clue.text: Initially provided set up in new start

indicators.note: in puts one piece inside another
new signals the letters of the word that follows are rearranged
in a down clue, set up means written upwards, so read backwards

parts.note: if means provided that

explanation.surface: Something given a fresh start was assembled at the beginning.
explanation.walkthrough: 'set up' turns the conditional word upwards into FI, which 'in' places inside ATRST, made by 'new' from the fodder.
explanation.definitionFit: The phrase means at the beginning, a synonym of initially.

clue.text: Take the stand at trial

parts.note: a test is a trial of something

explanation.surface: A witness gives evidence at a court hearing.
explanation.walkthrough: 'trial' suggests a courtroom but here means a test; 'Take the stand' is the definition.
explanation.definitionFit: A witness who takes the stand testifies, bearing witness to the truth of something.

clue.text: Swingers' bar

parts.note: sounds like a nightclub for partygoers, but means the horizontal bar acrobats swing on

explanation.definitionFit: A circus apparatus: a crossbar hung on ropes on which acrobats swing.

clue.text: Raised voice in row on river

indicators.note: in an across clue, a piece on another is attached after it, so row follows river

parts.note: the Fal is a river in Cornwall
a set-to is a quarrel or fight

explanation.surface: Someone shouts during an argument on a riverbank.
explanation.walkthrough: The FAL is a river in Cornwall, south-west England; 'in' is a link. A set-to is a British word for a heated quarrel.
explanation.definitionFit: A falsetto is the high, artificially raised register of a male singing voice.

clue.text: Record a stage direction

definitions.meaning: to write down in a list or log
an instruction in a script for an actor to come on

explanation.definitionFit: The word means to write data in a register and is the script instruction to come on stage.

clue.text: Housework to the French is fair game

parts.note: HO is short for house and OP (opus) means work
la is the French feminine word for the

explanation.surface: A French domestic chore is said to be a legitimate target.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Housework' splits into House (HO) and work (OP); hoop-la is a funfair game of throwing rings over prizes.
explanation.definitionFit: Hoop-la is a fairground stall game where rings are tossed over prizes, so a fair game.

clue.text: He's good and early!

definitions.meaning: a religious man, a monk heading a house of his order

explanation.definitionFit: The word names a monastic superior and means earlier or preceding in time.

clue.text: Matters of give and take between our betters

definitions.text: Matters of give and take between our betters

parts.words: Matters of give and take between our betters
parts.note: betters read as those who bet: bookmakers and punters give and take prices on a horse

explanation.definitionFit: Betting prices that bookmakers offer and punters accept, the ratio of stake to payout.

clue.text: Right! Breathe out and relax!

parts.note: to emit is to give out, as breath

explanation.surface: An instructor tells a class to exhale and unwind.
explanation.walkthrough: To remit is to slacken or ease off, an older sense of 'relax'.
explanation.definitionFit: To remit an effort or penalty is to ease it off, a less common sense of loosening.

clue.text: Subject to job stress

parts.note: under means subject to, as in under orders
a line is a line of work, a trade

explanation.surface: A worker suffers from occupational stress.
explanation.walkthrough: 'stress' looks like strain at work, but it is the verb: to emphasise.
explanation.definitionFit: To underline a point is to emphasise or stress it.

clue.text: Revolutionary gowns by Peter French

parts.note: robes are long gowns
Pierre is the French form of the name Peter

explanation.surface: Garments made by a Frenchman called Peter for the cause.
explanation.walkthrough: 'by' is a link joining the pieces side by side.
explanation.definitionFit: Maximilien Robespierre was a leading figure of the French Revolution and the Terror.
